findings.fix: Use `let e := ContinuousLinearEquiv.piCongrLeft ℂ (fun _ : ι => ℂ) (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm`. Get inverse cancellation from `e.symm_apply_apply`/`e.apply_symm_apply`, and the `update` compatibility from `Equiv.piCongrLeft'_update`/`Equiv.piCongrLeft'_symm_update` (unfold with simp). Then drop `hMN`, `hMupdate` and `hfMN`.

findings.evidence: Same proof shape at all three locations; Mathlib has only `hasFDerivAt_update`/`fderiv_update` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/FDeriv/Pi.lean:22,35) and no composite lemma.
findings.fix: Add one helper, e.g. `DifferentiableAt.comp_update (h : DifferentiableAt ℂ f y) (i) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun x => f (update y i x)) (y i)`, built from `hasFDerivAt_update`, and use it at all three sites (the `closedBall` site via `.differentiableAt` after restricting to the open ball).
findings.issue: The diff proves 'joint differentiability at `y` implies the slice `fun x => f (update y i x)` is differentiable at `y i`' three separate times: in `DifferentiableOn.torusIntegral_prod_sub_inv_smul` (≈l.197-203), in `analyticOnNhd_iff_continuousOn_and_differentiableAt_update` (l.349-351) and in `DifferentiableOn.analyticAt_of_finiteDimensional` (l.371-375). Each copy is `DifferentiableAt.comp (y i) _ (hasFDerivAt_update y (y i)).differentiableAt` followed by `rw [update_eq_self]`.

summary: Osgood's lemma is new: grepping Mathlib and TauCeti for Osgood, Hartogs and separate holomorphy finds no existing version. The transport to `Fin n → ℂ` hand-builds an equivalence Mathlib already has, and the diff writes the same update-differentiability argument out three times.
